Episode 257. The Demon Army's Attack (14)
The Crimson Sword. First, Luna's Krantel tore through the enemy's lines.
'Is she really human, having moved all the way here while enduring that barrage until just now...!'

The Demon Army in the front ranks, who had barely blocked the blow, gritted their teeth and glared at Luna. She was clearly not a transcendent being like Chiron or Vahn, but a Genesis Knight just like them.

Moreover, she had started the fight under worse conditions and broken through a more difficult path. Naturally, her stamina should have been depleted, yet Krantel was striking the enemies more fiercely and violently than ever before.
She had already lost one sibling.

There was no way she didn't know that Haytona had lost his life defending the center of the battlefield for the Genesis Knights. She was just in a fight so intense that she couldn't even take a moment to grieve.
But this time, Jin had nearly died right before her eyes. Luna was wrapping her blade in all the uncontrollable, swirling rage, hatred, and desire for revenge.

"I am the sword that protects Runcandel. That fact has never changed in any dimension, and this time, I will never lose everything. I will annihilate you all and ensure the members of my family can return to the Garden of Swords!"
Luna's sword, swung with a shout, seemed ferocious and unrefined. It looked like her old self's sword, merely wild and destructive.
However, Eltiot did not chide her upon seeing her sword. The calm within the storm; Luna's sword was, in fact, reaching the ideal of harmony that he pursued.
Fierce yet precise, rough yet flexible. In a way, sorrow and hatred were completing her sword.
On the verge of either falling into demonization or becoming more complete, she had not fallen into the trap.

It was possible because she had conviction. A heart that those who fight merely for destruction and conquest could not realize, a heart they would be forced to forget even if they had once realized it.
Though red tears of sorrow and resentment flowed from her eyes, her vision was endlessly clear, ceaselessly spotting the enemies' weaknesses.
Sgeuk-!
A Genesis Knight of the Demon Army was bisected by the crimson-stained Krantel. He was in a state where he couldn't properly counterattack due to the pressure of the Plutonian Cannon.

Most of the Demon Army's Genesis Knights were the same. It was a situation where they were being attacked one-sidedly despite having an overwhelming numerical advantage, which was why they had tried to kill Jin by any means necessary.

The Coalition's Genesis Knights were deliberately penetrating deep into the Demon Army's formation. Their intention was to fight while enduring the Plutonian Cannon by using the enemy's protective shields.
"Block them! If they get in any further, it's over!"

A desperate shout, so urgent it cracked, came from within the Demon Army's formation. Of course, they couldn't possibly deactivate their linked protective shields. That would be tantamount to collective suicide.

Furthermore, with Chiron and Vahn on the Coalition's side, doing so would only give them a greater advantage. It was a checkmate; the Demon Army had to endure this uncomfortable fight until the Plutonian Cannon ended.
[You don't think the Plutonian Cannon ends with just one shot, do you? You stupid bastards.]
Orgal shouted while covering for Luna.

From the beginning, Jin had started the battle with two shots from the Plutonian Cannon remaining. With Qwaul's maintenance, even after expending one shot, they were slated to be able to fire at least two more times.
If this composition could be maintained, it was entirely possible for the Coalition's Genesis Knights to literally massacre the thirty Genesis Knights of the Demon Army.
'Dammit, to be pushed back even after doing all this...!'
The shocks continued. Rondo felt his mind reeling as he surveyed the battlefield. Genesis Knights were falling futilely, unable to even counterattack once.
'If the bombardment continues just one more time, it's practically annihilation. But we won't go down like that!'
He decided to change the plan once more.

"All Genesis Knights of the Demon Army, listen! As soon as the bombardment ends, scatter! Scatter in all directions of the battlefield to induce a chaotic melee, and focus only on assassinating Jin Runcandel!"
Rondo now decided to exclude 'victory'.
He decided to accept the terrible fact that they could be defeated by the heroes of a single world, even after committing a fleet of tens of thousands and nearly thirty Genesis Knights.

But even if they lost the battle, they could still win the war. Even if they lost all their forces, as long as they killed Jin within the remaining time, the Vamel Alliance had no future. Even if Chiron, Vahn, and all the rest survived, they could never turn the tide without Solderet's legacy.

Rondo deliberately timed his command to the moment the bombardment ended. As soon as his words finished, the barrage subsided, and the Demon Army's Genesis Knights immediately began to break away from the battlefield.
"Where do you think you're going? And you prattled on about being the hegemon of all dimensions!"
Jin shouted as he fired a sword aura at a Genesis Knight trying to leave the battlefield. But inside, he was burning with anxiety.
'To have the Genesis Knights withdraw now means they have no intention of winning the battle. Are they planning to wait for Kelliark? Or...'
Jin couldn't help but be confused. The Demon Army had displayed such confidence, even using their Genesis Knights as arrow fodder, but now they seemed to have given up on victory.
Thwang-! Krrrck!
Chiron and Vahn deflected a magic beam aimed at Jin and stuck by his side.
"Brother Jin, I think they've decided to focus only on killing you."

"...I was just thinking the same thing, Sister Vahn. It must be a decision made conscious of Solderet's legacy. Their judgment must be that if they can prevent me from obtaining that power, they'll ultimately win the war even if they lose everything in this battle. Or, they've decided to buy time until Kelliark arrives."
Jin quickly grasped Rondo's intention. Solderet's legacy; the enemy was most wary of that unidentified, transcendent power.
Twenty-four, the number of surviving enemy Genesis Knights when the Plutonian Cannon ended.
About thirty percent of those desperately trying to escape the battlefield would die from the remaining shots of the Plutonian Cannon before they could join other fronts.

The remaining seventy percent wouldn't all be safe either. Those with serious injuries would quickly fall to the combined attacks of the Coalition's Genesis Knights. Especially since they were no longer in a proper formation like before, they couldn't avoid being picked off one by one. This was because even for a Genesis Knight, there was no one who could handle Chiron and Vahn.
However, from now on, it was the Coalition, not the Demon Army, that would be led by the nose. Because the Coalition had to chase the scattered Genesis Knights of the Demon Army.
In other words, the Demon Army had given up victory in exchange for taking the initiative.
'Once the enemy Genesis Knights start breaking into the central battlefield, we'll have to suffer many sacrifices even if we win.'
Grind! Jin gritted his teeth and gripped his sword.
"If the Plutonian Cannon can be operated at least four more times, we can minimize our casualties."
"We'll have to trust in Qwaul. Brother Jin, from now on, Chiron and I will stick by your side, so we can protect you even if the enemy Genesis Knights suddenly swarm you all at once."
Jin nodded.
If Chiron and Vahn were tied down to Jin, that many more allies would die to enemy Genesis Knights on other fronts, but it couldn't be helped.
"Understood. Let's start moving. Three o'clock direction. That bastard whose arm was cut off by Sister Vahn's sword a moment ago, let's deal with him first and begin the pursuit."

Of course, the two of them wouldn't just stay in one place to protect Jin. On the contrary, the three of them, including Jin, had to be the most active in pursuing enemy Genesis Knights. After all, Chiron and Vahn were needed to finish off enemy Genesis Knights quickly.
"Central battlefield, slowly retreat the front line!"
Eltiot adjusted the allies' positions in response to the rapidly changing flow of the battlefield, and in the meantime, Lafrarosa located the enemy Genesis Knights and reloaded its main cannon.
Kwaaaaaa...!

The moment the golden tsunami exploded from the cannon's barrel, the Demon Army's Genesis Knights could not withstand the force as they had before. It was a natural result, as the Demon Army's Genesis Knights were breaking away from the battlefield in groups of at most three.

But while some were dying from the Plutonian Cannon, there were Genesis Knights who were entering the central battlefield. They instantly shot down the golden ships, putting pressure on the superhumans, and the Coalition Genesis Knights were always one step too late in stopping them.

It was because they were still outnumbered. Moreover, since they couldn't fire the Plutonian Cannon at enemies mixed with allies, the enemies were showing their prowess as Genesis Knights for the first time.

If there was any silver lining, it was that the Demon Army did not penetrate too deeply into the Coalition's lines. As their goal was to kill Jin, they had to secure a distance from which they could aim for Jin at any time.
"Forty hours until the curse is lifted. As long as Kelliark doesn't come, protecting you won't be a problem, brother."
However, it was unavoidable that they would have to endure the sacrifice of their allies for that.
Vahn swallowed her next words and wrapped Sigmund in lightning aura.
"A strange thing, this is."
Passage 1, Demon Army Headquarters.

Octavia turned to Keliak as he muttered unexpectedly. Octavia had been just about to start meditating to absorb the magic and authority he had given her. Even though the power had not yet been fully refined, she had transformed into a youthful appearance, as if in her twenties.
"What is it, Lord Kelliark?"
"I have never once seen Silyn handle matters carelessly."
"Silyn... that's the person you mentioned before. A very remarkable person, unlike me."
Kelliark let out a chuckle as if finding Octavia's lingering resentment amusing.
"Yes, that Silyn has momentarily lost a rebel on the battlefield of the Black Sea. Thanks to that, the Vamel Alliance has seized the chance for victory, and Rondo has been pushed into a corner."
Soon, Kelliark silently thought of Silyn for a while.
If it was a rebel that Silyn couldn't handle perfectly, there was only one person. The leader of the Gray Owl who had survived dozens of encounters with Kelliark, Valeria Hister.
"...I was trying not to move until my recovery was perfectly complete, but it seems it would be best for me to go in person."
"Will it not be dangerous? If Malugia appears then..."
At those words, Kelliark shrugged his shoulders and replied.
"Then that would be a good thing for me. I'll just subdue Malugia on this occasion. Prepare yourself, we will go right now."
